title: Not-found path returns HTTP 500, not 404
evidence: src/main/java/com/bookapi/service/ResourceNotFoundException.java:3 is a plain RuntimeException with no @ResponseStatus; grep finds no @ControllerAdvice/@RestControllerAdvice/@ExceptionHandler anywhere in src/main. BookController.getBookById (BookController.java:60) throws it on a missing id, so Spring's default handler returns 500. R4's how_to_verify requires '404 if absent'. Happy-path get-by-id works (BookController.java:58-62).
suggestion: Add @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND) to ResourceNotFoundException or a @RestControllerAdvice mapping it to 404.

title: Three not-found tests fail (expect 404, get 500)
evidence: BookControllerTest.testGetBookByIdNotFound:158, testUpdateBookNotFound:189, testDeleteBookNotFound:222 all andExpect(status().isNotFound()) but the unmapped ResourceNotFoundException yields 500. Consistent with test_coverage=0.6667 (<1.0) in scores.json.
suggestion: Fix the 404 mapping (see R4); the tests already encode the correct contract.

title: Not all HTTP status codes are correct (404 case wrong)
evidence: 201 (BookController.java:37 created), 200 (:54/:61/:69), 400 (@Valid + @NotBlank) are correct, but the not-found case returns 500 instead of 404 — same root cause as R4. R8 how_to_verify lists 404 among required codes.
suggestion: Same fix as R4 restores the 404 code.

title: Health endpoint at /api/books/health, not /health
evidence: BookController.java:78 @GetMapping("/health") is nested under @RequestMapping("/api/books") (BookController.java:18), so the actual path is /api/books/health. R10 asks for a GET /health route; a request to /health returns 404. README documents it as /api/books/health too.
suggestion: Expose the health check at /health (a separate top-level controller or Spring Boot Actuator).

title: Unused import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
evidence: BookController.java:9 imports HttpStatus but it is never referenced in the file (grep of src/main for non-import HttpStatus usage is empty) — a symptom of the intended-but-omitted 404 status wiring.
suggestion: Remove the unused import or use it to set the not-found status.
